And not sure I follow "As long as the default honest behavior of clients is to build on full even if they saw the payload late, I think this should be fine". If a data-small compute-heavy payload arrives at the deadline, you might only have e.g. 2s to execute it, and just not be able to extend it you could say that it's just bad for the builder and they wouldn't, but actually as things are right now the attesters of the next slot have a few extra seconds and they might well be able to execute in time
